High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicants under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking anticipatory bail in connection with RCT No.549/2012 registered at Police Station Sendari, District Niwadi, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of the IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that other accused persons have been granted bail and there is a dispute regarding the appointment of Anganwadi worker.

There is litigation and multiple writs have been filed, the case travelled from Collector to Commissioner and the High Court, High Court to Commissioner, Commissioner to Collector and then to Commissioner, thus,
there is a serious civil dispute between the parties.

There is only dispute regarding the domicile/
place of resident of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55877 2 MCRC-41564-2025 applicant No.2 and applicant No.1 is the husband of applicant No.2.
Complaint will take time to be decided finally, hence, the applicant be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. Learned counsel for the objector has submitted that these are the main accused persons and they have made forged documents regarding the resident of applicant No.2 and due to that, she obtained the employment as an Anganwadi worker and the Collector, in its last order, has cancelled her appointment, hence, it is clearly proved that the documents were forged and in such serious matter,
the bail should not be entertained, hence, the bail application be dismissed.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/State has also opposed the anticipatory bail application and has submitted that no case of anticipatory bail is made out.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
6. Various writ petitions were filed before this Court and some writ petitions regarding this are pending.

The matter was also disputed before the Collector, Commissioner and looking to the factual aspects that there is dispute regarding the employment and the Corporator and other Government servants has been also made the accused in this case. Taking into consideration that the trial will take time to be concluded.
Case is based on the documents filed by applicants with the application before the Collector/C.E.O.
hence, this Court deems it appropriate to allow the application.
Thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:55877 3 MCRC-41564-2025 7 .

It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicants shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for their appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.

8 . It is further directed that the applicants shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, the M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
